path_info

Path Planning Information Container for TurtleBot Soccer Player.

This module defines the PathInfo dataclass which stores all necessary information for navigation and path planning during soccer operations.

Classes

PathInfo(pin_vectors, circle_radius, ...)

Centralized storage for path planning and navigation information.
